subject.title: refactor(config): add canonical group-policy scope-tree resolver and migrate the first six channels

question: Should ScopeTree and its low-level resolution helpers become a permanent public openclaw/plugin-sdk/channel-policy contract at this stage of the channel migration?
rationale: The architecture requires an SDK boundary for plugin code, but publishing the representation now creates compatibility obligations before the remaining richer channel shapes have exercised it.

options.title: Approve the public contract
options.body: Accept these eight exports as durable SDK surface, require representative live parity proof, and land the consolidated migration after checks are refreshed.

options.title: Keep the model bundled-internal
options.body: Pause the public exports and provide a narrower bundled-plugin facade until Discord, Telegram, Teams, and other richer scopes validate the final abstraction.

recommendation.title: Approve the public contract
recommendation.body: Accept these eight exports as durable SDK surface, require representative live parity proof, and land the consolidated migration after checks are refreshed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged group-policy work and the current normalization design place this person closest to the intended long-term API boundary.
